text.tspan: Income share of the richest 10% before and after tax
The share of income received by the richest 10% of the population. Income is measured before taxes on the
horizontal axis and after taxes on the vertical axis. The latest available estimates are shown for each country.
Note: Income has been equivalized to allow for fairer comparisons in living standards between households of different sizes or age
compositions. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2034 is shown instead.
